About Dave

A craftsman.
A father. A good person.

20+ years building and finishing homes across Northern Colorado — one job at a time, with his own two hands.

Who Dave is

More than a contractor.
Someone you can count on.

Dave Pequite has spent over 20 years building and finishing homes across Northern Colorado. He works alone — because doing the work himself is the only way to deliver the quality he genuinely cares about.

He’s a single dad and a passionate rock climber. Both have shaped how he operates on the job. Climbing teaches you that preparation matters, honesty about the route keeps everyone safe, and you are fully accountable for every move you make.

“The mountain has a way of showing you who you really are. I try to bring that same honesty and care into every home I work in.”
Genuine
Straightforward. Loves his craft. What you see is what you get.
Skilled
Two decades of precision work. The results speak for themselves.
Reliable
Shows up when he says. Finishes what he starts.
Caring
Genuinely wants your home to be better.

“I’m raising my kid on this work.
There’s no better reason to do it right.”

— Dave on why every project is personal
